Aisha Noor: Heads up Candidate Lina Gomez (Data Eng) requested a hybrid interview on Tue Jul 12. She's in CET and prefers afternoon there (morning PT). Wants remote technical loop then optional short onsite for a whiteboard and tour. She also asked about accommodations: latex-free meeting room and a quiet space due to sensory sensitivity. Can people-ops help coordinate?
Ben Holt: I can take scheduling. Lina said she can do 15:00-18:00 CET (06:00-09:00 PT). Which slot fits the panel? We need 3x45m interviews + 30m debrief and a 30m onsite slot if needed.
Rita Shah: I can prereg the badge and reserve a latex-free room (Room A2). For quiet space, we can allocate the focus booth next to reception. Need full name as on ID, email, phone, and note for latex-free. Also, loaner laptop available on request.
Aisha Noor: Lina's email: lina.gomez.candidate@example.com, passport name: Lina Alejandra Gomez, phone: +34 600 123 456. She prefers a printed badge and asked if we reimburse commuter train (~€22).
people-ops-bot: Reimbursement reminder: local transit under $75 or equivalent: submit receipt to expenses@redwood.com within 30 days. For special accommodations, email accessibility@redwood.com. Internal link: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/reimbursements
Ben Holt: Tentative schedule (PT): 06:00-06:45 tech interview 1, 07:00-07:45 tech interview 2, 08:00-08:45 culture/pm, optional 16:30-17:00 onsite tour. I'll send calendar invites with Zoom and note about live captions and quiet room.
Rita Shah: Badge prereg done; printed badge will be at reception. Focus booth reserved 16:15-17:15. Loaner laptop: please request via asset-requests@redwood.com 24h in advance.
Aisha Noor: Action items: Ben finalize invites and include latex-free + quiet room notes; Rita confirm printed badge and loaner hold; Lina to confirm whether she wants onsite after remote.
Ben Holt: Invites out, candidate confirmed remote loop and noted she'd likely take onsite if screening goes well. She thanked us and confirmed vegetarian lunch note.
people-ops-bot: Candidate profile updated: "Lina Gomez  latex-free room; quiet space requested; printed badge; reimbursement guidance sent.""
